articles.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
articles.summary: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. articles.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models often exceed a single accelerator's memory capacity. articles.summary: Long-horizon terminal agents may solve a task in one run yet fail across repeated runs. articles.summary: Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. articles.summary: Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. articles.summary: Enterprise agents answer questions over workplace records that evolve through team collaboration. articles.title: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
articles.summary: Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows.
